stops.text: 6 RESURRECTING ATLANTIS · A The Light Gates open — “The gates open with wings”
6 RESURRECTING ATLANTIS · B Road down, following comets — “down yellow brick roads”
6 RESURRECTING ATLANTIS · C The city rises / here we are all one — “resurrecting Atlantis”
6 RESURRECTING ATLANTIS · D Jungle Interface and the heart-scan admission — “the pact we've made here with nature”
6 RESURRECTING ATLANTIS · E City Center: all safe — “But here we are all safe”
6 RESURRECTING ATLANTIS · F Narrow streets by candlelight — “flickering candle light”
6 RESURRECTING ATLANTIS · G Could stay forever, then wandering to the house — “I know my soul”
